title: World bosses
summary: The Hollow King and the Mother of Thorns, the server-wide bosses that rise in the survival world, and the region bosses.

Everyone within 6 blocks takes damage (10 vanilla damage points, which is 50 Health, before your Defense) and is thrown back. Keep your distance, or stay behind it when you see the particles.
The boss calls its helpers in a ring around it and warns you. They are level 25 and level 20 mobs, so kill them quickly or fight away from them.

Minions disappear when the boss dies or leaves. Creative and spectator players are not hit by the slam.

Ranged weapons are the safest way to damage a world boss. Stay outside the 6 block slam ring, shoot, and move away when it calls minions. Armour with plenty of Defense and Health makes a slam survivable, and a Training Dummy tells you how much damage your build really does. See
Everyone who damaged the boss is paid when it falls, whether or not they landed the last hit. The
(x1.5) of the coins, seals, Combat XP and rare drop chance.

The top damager's rare drop chance is 12% (Hollow King) or 60% (Mother of Thorns). The rare and bonus drops are rolled separately for each player, and Magic Find does not change these chances. A chat message shows what you earned and where you ranked.
A Nightmare Core sells for 15,000 coins and a Dread Fang for 1,200. A Golden Pet Egg is one of the rarest drops in the game. See

Danger regions have bosses of their own. They do not rise on a timer. You wake one by using a Heart Sigil at the region's shrine, or during a Blood Moon, when each heart wakes its boss if someone comes near. They are fought in the same way as a dungeon boss, with their own moves.
